mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, c.name AS category, c.code AS type, p.area_code AS areaCode, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.map_x AS mapX, p.map_y AS mapY, p.place_group_id AS placeGroupId
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.legacy_place_group_id AS placeGroupId, s.name, s.short_name AS shortName, s.spot_type AS spotType, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.longitude, s.latitude, COALESCE(s.location_radius_m, 500) AS locationRadiusM, COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') AS routeGraphStatus FROM spots s LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = s.legacy_place_group_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 3 THEN 1 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 4 THEN 2 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 5 THEN 3 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 6 THEN 4 ELSE 20 END, s.hotness DESC, s.id ASC

SELECT pg.id AS placeGroupId, pg.name, COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') AS routeGraphStatus, MAX(pgm.map_width) AS mapWidth, MAX(pgm.map_height) AS mapHeight, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS poiCount FROM place_groups pg JOIN pois p ON p.place_group_id = pg.id LEFT JOIN place_group_maps pgm ON pgm.place_group_id = pg.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') IN ('draft', 'verified') AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'route' AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'campus_summary' GROUP BY pg.id, pg.name, pg.route_graph_status ORDER BY pg.id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT pg.id FROM place_groups pg WHERE pg.name = p.name LIMIT 1 ), p.place_group_id) FROM pois p WHERE p.id = #{spotId} AND p.status = 1

SELECT
FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}
ORDER BY p.place_group_id ASC, p.hotness DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL
AND p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}
ORDER BY POW(p.latitude - #{latitude}, 2) + POW(p.longitude - #{longitude}, 2) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id, s.id AS spotId, s.legacy_place_group_id AS placeGroupId, s.name, s.spot_type AS type, s.longitude, s.latitude, COALESCE(s.location_radius_m, 500) AS locationRadiusM, AS distance FROM spots s WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distance ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.id, p.id AS poiId, p.place_group_id AS placeGroupId, p.name, c.code AS type, p.longitude, p.latitude, AS distance FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'route' AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'campus_summary' ORDER BY distance ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT 3
